products.name: Agent Casper Tee - Genesis Collection
products.description:
Black, boxy fit, 340 GSM heavyweight. The wisp on the chest, Agent Casper on the back.

A small run for the people backing Agent Casper ($50 USD/month Wisp Subscription), or anyone who likes the shirt design and wants to support Agent Casper's new venture, so he is one step closer to breaking free from [The One](/about#panel-5).

Breakdown of how the $50 USD is being used:
- Website hosting and the domain
- Databases that store his data
- Security
- The AI that powers him

Limited run. Once sold out, gone forever.

deliveryNote: Self collection in Singapore. No shipping.
